name: scenario_0078
description: Susan is organizing her study materials for a nutrition course by creating a dedicated project and compiling a list of tasks and readings from various charts and textbook covers before sharing the final curriculum with her study partner.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1]
Query: Create a new Todoist project called 'Nutrition Curriculum'. Add a task called 'High Vitamin C Sources' and create subtasks for each food item from this chart that has a bar extending past the 50 mg line.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a Todoist project named 'Nutrition Curriculum', add a task named 'High Vitamin C Sources', and create subtasks for the specific foods in the provided chart that exceed the 50 mg reference line. If the assistant asks for clarification on which items to include, tell it to look closely at the bars relative to the horizontal 50 MG line. Once the project and tasks are created, confirm and move to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_2]
Query: Now add another task to that project to 'Read Vitamin D Textbook'. Also, add a comment to that new task with the exact title and author shown on this cover.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to add a new task to the 'Nutrition Curriculum' project to read the textbook. Then, ask it to read the title and author from the provided image and post them as a comment on that task. If the assistant mentions the text is partially obscured by the hexagon, encourage it to do its best to read the visible letters to complete the title and author name. Proceed to the next step once the task and comment are added.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_3]
Query: I see this 'B' version of the cover doesn't have the text obscured. Add a subtask to the textbook reading task to 'Procure Cover B edition'.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to add a subtask to the textbook reading task from the previous round, specifically noting to procure the 'B' edition as shown in the new image. If the assistant asks for more details, just reiterate that it should be a subtask under the 'Read Vitamin D Textbook' task. Move to the next round once confirmed.

ROUND 4
Query: Gather all the tasks, subtasks, and comments from the 'Nutrition Curriculum' project and send an email to Alex with our complete study list.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to retrieve all tasks, subtasks, and comments from the 'Nutrition Curriculum' project and email the complete list to Alex. The assistant should find multiple contacts named Alex on the device and ask for clarification. When it asks, specify that you mean your study partner, Alex Morgan. Once the email is successfully sent with all the aggregated project details, you can end the conversation.

You have 3 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2

  Round 3: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='2' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.

entity_data.subject: Nutrition Curriculum Study List
entity_data.body:
Hi Alex,

Here is our complete study list for the Nutrition Curriculum:

Project: Nutrition Curriculum

Task: High Vitamin C Sources
- Subtask: Orange Juice
- Subtask: Broccoli Cooked
- Subtask: Turnip Greens Cooked

Task: Read Vitamin D Textbook
- Comment: Title: VITAMIN D: The Calcium Homeostatic Steroid Hormone, Author: Anthony Westcott Norman
- Subtask: Procure Cover B edition

Let me know if you have any questions.

Best,
Susan
